fact: A World Bank technical note of December 2025, prepared with FIRST and INTIC, reports Mozambique's progress since the 2021 cybersecurity policy and strategy (Resolution 69/2021), with a national CSIRT and sectoral and provincial CSIRTs already operating in the national CSIRT network.
title: Relatório do Banco Mundial Destaca Avanços Significativos na Segurança Cibernética em Moçambique
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação (INTIC)
